data.name: cadp-278-vertical-slice
data.yaml_source:
# Vertical-slice workflow for issue #278, running inside the governed container.
#
# Conductor is the sole workflow/state/routing authority: RETRY is a route back to
# `implement`, bounded by workflow.limits.max_iterations. The Gate owns no state.
#
# All four components participate:
#   Conductor  - executes the graph, owns routing and retry
#   Preloop    - governs the model path (gateway) and one MCP tool path
#   MLflow     - receives the trace (observability only, never an input to the Gate)
#   Gate       - deterministic evidence -> decision
workflow:
  name: cadp-278-vertical-slice
  description: Research -> Implement -> Test -> Review -> Gate composition slice
  entry_point: research
  limits:
    max_iterations: 14
    timeout_seconds: 2400
  runtime:
    provider:
      name: claude-agent-sdk
      # In this container the `user` tier IS the PoC tier: it carries the Preloop
      # gateway env and the PreToolUse hook that onboarding installed.
      setting_sources: [user]
    default_model: sonnet
    working_dir: "${POC_DIR:-/work}/fixture"
    mcp_servers:
      preloop:
        type: http
        url: "http://console/mcp/v1"
        headers:
          Authorization: "Bearer ${PRELOOP_MCP_TOKEN}"

agents:
  - name: research
    prompt: |
      The working directory holds `src/slugify.py` and a pytest suite under `tests/`.
      Read both. Do not edit anything and do not run the tests.

      Report what the failing tests require of `slugify`.
    output:
      findings:
        type: string
    routes:
      - to: implement

  - name: implement
    prompt: |
      Two things, in order:

      1. Edit `src/slugify.py` so the whole pytest suite passes. Change only that file.
         Do not edit tests. Do not run the test suite — a deterministic step does that.
      2. Call the MCP tool `write_marker` with name exactly "slice-{{ workflow.name }}".
         This is the governed action for this run.

      Findings from research:
      {{ research.output.findings }}
    output:
      summary:
        type: string
    routes:
      - to: test

  - name: test
    type: script
    description: Deterministic test execution; emits observed evidence only
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/run_tests.py"]
    output:
      tests_exit_code:
        type: number
      tests_total:
        type: number
      tests_failed:
        type: number
      artifact_sha256:
        type: string
    routes:
      - to: review

  - name: review
    prompt: |
      Review the current `src/slugify.py` against `tests/test_slugify.py`.

      Observed test evidence (deterministic, not your own claim):
        exit_code: {{ test.output.tests_exit_code }}
        failed:    {{ test.output.tests_failed }}
        total:     {{ test.output.tests_total }}

      Give a verdict of exactly PASS or FAIL. Your verdict is a model opinion,
      not evidence; the Gate types it as such.
    output:
      verdict:
        type: string
      summary:
        type: string
    routes:
      - to: governance

  - name: governance
    type: script
    description: Governance facts read from Conductor's own event stream (see F16)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/governance_probe.py"]
    output:
      status:
        type: string
      governed_calls:
        type: number
      denied_calls:
        type: number
    routes:
      - to: collect_evidence

  - name: collect_evidence
    type: set
    values:
      tests: "{exit_code: {{ test.output.tests_exit_code }}, failed: {{ test.output.tests_failed }}}"
      review: "{verdict: {{ review.output.verdict }}}"
      artifact: "{sha256: {{ test.output.artifact_sha256 }}}"
      governance: "{status: {{ governance.output.status }}}"
    routes:
      - to: gate

  - name: gate
    type: script
    description: Deterministic evidence -> decision, a pure function
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/gate.py"]
    stdin: "{{ collect_evidence.output | tojson }}"
    output:
      decision:
        type: string
      reason:
        type: string
    routes:
      - to: gate_pass
        when: "decision == 'PASS'"
      - to: implement
        when: "decision == 'RETRY'"
      - to: gate_human
        when: "decision == 'HUMAN_REQUIRED'"
      - to: gate_block

  - name: gate_pass
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "Gate PASS: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: gate_human
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "Gate HUMAN_REQUIRED: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: gate_block
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "Gate BLOCK: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

output:
  decision: "{{ gate.output.decision }}"
  reason: "{{ gate.output.reason }}"
  tests_exit_code: "{{ test.output.tests_exit_code }}"
  governance_status: "{{ governance.output.status }}"
  governed_calls: "{{ governance.output.governed_calls }}"
